case_title: Dr. Lakshman v. The State of Karnataka & Ors.
offence_finally_established: Cheating, criminal conspiracy, criminal breach of trust
neutral_facts: The accused entered into an agreement with the appellant to procure 70 acres of agricultural land and received an amount of Rs.9 crores. The accused failed to perform the contract and entered into another MOU, representing they were in possession of the land. The accused sold the land covered by Survey Nos.115 and 117 to a third party prior to the agreement. The accused issued cheques as security for the advance payment, but the account was closed before the agreement. The appellant was forced to sign the sale deed for the lands covered by Survey Nos.115 and 117. The accused also failed to register the sale deeds as promised. The appellant filed a complaint alleging cheating, fraud, and criminal conspiracy against the accused.
